'''93D's''' was a chop shop located in the [[Slips]] of [[Point Nadir]]. It was run by a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] named [[93D]], and employed an all-droid workforce. It specialized in the stripping and refitting of [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The shop had room to work on small vehicles locally, and 93D would move his workforce to the location of a larger vehicle if he was hired for a job.<ref name="SaV" />
